title: Darlington BWRX-300 SMR 工程
summary: 以小型沸水模組、自然循環與施工階段解析Darlington BWRX-300 SMR 工程：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore Darlington BWRX-300 SMR engineering through small bwr modules, natural circulation and construction stages: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。
scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. Examples are hypothetical; qualified professionals govern actual equipment.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在Darlington BWRX-300 SMR 工程案例中比較小型BWR蒸汽邊界與模塊與汽輪轉換，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate small-bwr steam boundaries and module/turbine conversion within the Darlington BWRX-300 SMR engineering case.

steps.title: 核島與汽輪機島邊界：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Nuclear and turbine-island boundaries: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對小型BWR蒸汽邊界提出可反駁的核島與汽輪機島邊界模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable nuclear and turbine-island boundaries model and evidence record for small-bwr steam boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在「Darlington BWRX-300 SMR 工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識小型BWR蒸汽邊界。和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。 建立核島與汽輪機島邊界的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是小型沸水模組、自然循環與施工階段。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify small-bwr steam boundaries in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Darlington BWRX-300 SMR engineering. Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nuclear and turbine-island boundaries, focusing on small bwr modules, natural circulation and construction stages. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。
steps.observationEn: Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有核電架構都有完全相同的主次迴路。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: All nuclear architectures have identical primary/secondary loops.
steps.check: 提交小型BWR蒸汽邊界的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for small-bwr steam boundaries.

knowledge.title: 核島與汽輪機島邊界
knowledge.text: 和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。 本課架構對應：小型BWR蒸汽邊界
knowledge.textEn: Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries. Course architecture correspondence: Small-BWR steam boundaries

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；所有核電架構都有完全相同的主次迴路。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: All nuclear architectures have identical primary/secondary loops.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設民用熱源 700 MWth、熱電效率 0.30、輔機 12 MWe，淨電=700×0.30−12=198.0 MWe；循環排熱約490.0 MW。僅熱平衡，不含反應性、燃料製造或操作整定。
knowledge.textEn: Assume civil heat input 700 MWth, efficiency 0.30 and auxiliaries 12 MWe: net power 198.0 MWe; cycle rejection about 490.0 MW. This is heat balance only, without reactivity, fuel manufacture or operating settings.

quiz.question: 就小型BWR蒸汽邊界的「核島與汽輪機島邊界」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for nuclear and turbine-island boundaries in small-bwr steam boundaries?
options: 和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。
所有核電架構都有完全相同的主次迴路。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries.
All nuclear architectures have identical primary/secondary loops.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。 在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。
quiz.explanationEn: Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries. Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram.

steps.title: 核島與汽輪機島邊界：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Nuclear and turbine-island boundaries: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對小型BWR蒸汽邊界提出可反駁的核島與汽輪機島邊界模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable nuclear and turbine-island boundaries model and evidence record for small-bwr steam boundaries.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「核島與汽輪機島邊界」模型，檢查小型BWR蒸汽邊界的兩個假想案例。在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous nuclear and turbine-island boundaries model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving small-bwr steam boundaries. Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。
steps.observationEn: Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有核電架構都有完全相同的主次迴路。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: All nuclear architectures have identical primary/secondary loops.
steps.check: 提交小型BWR蒸汽邊界的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for small-bwr steam boundaries.

steps.title: 熱循環與淨電效率：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Thermal cycles and net efficiency: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對模塊與汽輪轉換提出可反駁的熱循環與淨電效率模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable thermal cycles and net efficiency model and evidence record for module/turbine conversion.
steps.instruction: 在「Darlington BWRX-300 SMR 工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識模塊與汽輪轉換。熱電轉換受熱循環及輔機耗電共同影響；熱功率與淨電功率不同。 建立熱循環與淨電效率的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是小型沸水模組、自然循環與施工階段。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用假想熱平衡分別計算汽輪輸出、輔機與淨電。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify module/turbine conversion in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Darlington BWRX-300 SMR engineering. Cycle efficiency and auxiliaries affect conversion; thermal and net electrical power differ. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of thermal cycles and net efficiency, focusing on small bwr modules, natural circulation and construction stages. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate turbine output, auxiliaries and net power in an assumed balance. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 用假想熱平衡分別計算汽輪輸出、輔機與淨電。
steps.observationEn: Separate turbine output, auxiliaries and net power in an assumed balance.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：熱功率增加量必然等於可送電增加量。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Added thermal power necessarily equals added export power.
steps.check: 提交模塊與汽輪轉換的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for module/turbine conversion.

knowledge.title: 熱循環與淨電效率
knowledge.text: 熱電轉換受熱循環及輔機耗電共同影響；熱功率與淨電功率不同。 本課架構對應：模塊與汽輪轉換
knowledge.textEn: Cycle efficiency and auxiliaries affect conversion; thermal and net electrical power differ. Course architecture correspondence: Module/turbine conversion

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 用假想熱平衡分別計算汽輪輸出、輔機與淨電。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；熱功率增加量必然等於可送電增加量。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Separate turbine output, auxiliaries and net power in an assumed balance. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Added thermal power necessarily equals added export power.

quiz.question: 就模塊與汽輪轉換的「熱循環與淨電效率」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for thermal cycles and net efficiency in module/turbine conversion?
options: 熱功率增加量必然等於可送電增加量。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
熱電轉換受熱循環及輔機耗電共同影響；熱功率與淨電功率不同。
optionsEn: Added thermal power necessarily equals added export power.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
Cycle efficiency and auxiliaries affect conversion; thermal and net electrical power differ.
quiz.explanation: 熱電轉換受熱循環及輔機耗電共同影響；熱功率與淨電功率不同。 用假想熱平衡分別計算汽輪輸出、輔機與淨電。
quiz.explanationEn: Cycle efficiency and auxiliaries affect conversion; thermal and net electrical power differ. Separate turbine output, auxiliaries and net power in an assumed balance.
